mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by >1.0% m/m, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100k), rising wage pressures compress corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100k, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm employment growth indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of months when PAYEMS increases by >50k, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that disrupts supply chains and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly GDP and housing starts indicates broad-based economic strength that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth >1.0% q/q and HOUST >0.5% m/m, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime with CPIAUCSL >3.5% and FEDFUNDS <4.5%, delayed monetary tightening compresses real rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with delayed rate response (CPIAUCSL >3.5%, FEDFUNDS <4.5%)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL >3.5% and FEDFUNDS <4.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
